units.characteristics: the self-deceiving pride of the heart; the malice of gloating over a brother's fall
units.gist: THE GEM - 'THE PRIDE OF YOUR HEART HAS DECEIVED YOU... you who say in your heart, WHO WILL BRING ME DOWN?'; 'though you soar like the eagle... from there I will bring you down'; then the second sin - on the day Jacob fell 'YOU STOOD ALOOF... you were like one of them'; 'DO NOT GLOAT over the day of your brother, do not REJOICE over their ruin'; 'as you have done, it shall be done to you; your deeds shall return on your own head'
